replicate_network_across_gpus: replicate a PyTorch neural network across multiple GPU devices for data parallel training
check_module_replicatable: check if a PyTorch module and its descendants can be safely replicated across devices
broadcast_tensors_across_devices: broadcast coalesced tensors across multiple GPU devices with optional autograd support
detect_script_module: detect if a PyTorch module is a JIT ScriptModule for replication compatibility checks
check_jit_enabled: check if TorchScript JIT compilation is enabled in the current PyTorch runtime
